sentences.en: An oni will appear inevitably to those who fear oni.
sentences.zh: 那些害怕鬼的人不可避免地会遇到鬼。

sentences.en: Whoever reads this so-called newspaper every day will inevitably go daft.
sentences.zh: 每天读这份所谓的报纸的人最终难免会变得疯癫。

sentences.en: Every time I get really tired, I inevitably have a senior moment.
sentences.zh: 每次我真的很累的时候，总是免不了会出现老年痴呆的症状。
